api_type.quote: Our API is compatible with all common GraphQL clients with the following details:

api_breadth.value: GraphQL API with full read-write parity to the Plain UI; schema exposes queries and mutations, no endpoint count published.
api_breadth.quote: Plain itself is built on this same GraphQL API. This means that there are no limitations in what can be done via the API vs the UI.

docs_url.quote: These docs cover the most used operations. For anything not documented here, read the schema or get in touch (help@plain.com).

auth_methods.quote: A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime. Each API key carries its own fine-grained permissions. To call the API as a user in your workspace, use an OAuth app.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: `scope`: `openid`, plus `offline_access` if you want a refresh token.

access_model.quote: Every plan starts with a free 7-day trial, and the trial doesn't need a credit card.

access_notes.value: Free 7-day trial without a credit card; after the trial, a paid Foundation, Horizon, or Frontier plan is required. API keys are created self-serve for a machine user.
access_notes.quote: Every plan starts with a free 7-day trial, and the trial doesn't need a credit card.

official_mcp_server.quote: The Plain MCP server at `https://mcp.plain.com/mcp` lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.

rate_limits.value: Launch & Foundation: 450 requests/minute; Grow & Horizon: 600 requests/minute; Scale & Frontier: 1000 requests/minute.
rate_limits.quote: | Launch & Foundation | 450 requests/minute | | Grow & Horizon | 600 requests/minute | | Scale & Frontier | 1000 requests/minute |

webhooks.quote: Webhooks allow you to get notified about events happening in your Plain workspace.

sdk_languages.quote: If you're upgrading from the old `@team-plain/typescript-sdk` package, see the migration guide for a full breakdown of breaking changes.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: GraphQL API is exposed at a versioned /graphql/v1 endpoint; no formal API deprecation or sunset policy was found in the supplied evidence.

verdict_reason: Plain documents a public GraphQL API with API keys and OAuth, and the docs state the API has no limitations versus the Plain UI. A developer can start on a 7-day free trial without a credit card and create a machine-user API key self-serve. The API is broad (read-write GraphQL plus webhooks and an official MCP server), so the main friction is moving to a paid plan after the trial, not sales approval.
open_questions: The supplied evidence does not explicitly state whether the free 7-day trial includes API access; only the trial terms are documented.
No documented sandbox or test environment was found in the supplied evidence.
No formal API versioning, deprecation, or sunset policy was found; only a /graphql/v1 endpoint URL is documented.
No community MCP servers were found in the supplied evidence; only the official server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp is documented.
Only TypeScript is evidenced as an official SDK language; other vendor-maintained SDK languages were not found.
No public endpoint/resource count for the GraphQL API was found; breadth is assessed as full read-write parity with the UI.
